campaign_events_actor_identity.name: campaign_events_actor_identity

campaigns_submitted_pairing.name: campaigns_submitted_pairing
campaigns_submitted_pairing.value: ("campaigns"."submitted_by_user_id" is null and "campaigns"."submitted_at" is null) or ("campaigns"."submitted_by_user_id" is not null and "campaigns"."submitted_at" is not null)

campaigns_published_pairing.name: campaigns_published_pairing
campaigns_published_pairing.value: ("campaigns"."published_by_user_id" is null and "campaigns"."published_at" is null) or ("campaigns"."published_by_user_id" is not null and "campaigns"."published_at" is not null)

campaigns_cancelled_pairing.name: campaigns_cancelled_pairing
campaigns_cancelled_pairing.value: ("campaigns"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null and "campaigns"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("campaigns"."cancelled_by_user_id" is not null and "campaigns"."cancelled_at" is not null)

campaigns_dual_control.name: campaigns_dual_control

document_versions_scanned_pairing.name: document_versions_scanned_pairing

background_jobs_processing_lease_check.name: background_jobs_processing_lease_check
background_jobs_processing_lease_check.value: ("background_jobs"."status" = 'processing' and "background_jobs"."lease_owner" is not null) or ("background_jobs"."status" <> 'processing' and "background_jobs"."lease_owner" is null)

background_jobs_terminal_time_check.name: background_jobs_terminal_time_check
background_jobs_terminal_time_check.value:
("background_jobs"."status" = 'succeeded' and "background_jobs"."completed_at" is not null and "background_jobs"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("background_jobs"."status" = 'cancelled' and "background_jobs"."cancelled_at" is not null and "background_jobs"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("background_jobs"."status" not in ('succeeded', 'cancelled') and "background_jobs"."completed_at" is null and "background_jobs"."cancelled_at" is null)
